description:
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Drownyard Temple from the battlefield to your hand, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Drownyard Temple, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
